messages.content: Can AI reasoning costs decrease as models become more efficient?
Reasoning costs may decrease through improvements in model efficiency, hardware utilization, and inference scheduling.
If reasoning becomes cheaper, how will the role of human thinking change?
Human reasoning may become increasingly important for defining problems, evaluating assumptions, and determining which questions deserve attention.
Could preserved human-AI conversations become reusable research resources?
Preserved conversations may support future research when their original context, question references, and validation status are clearly distinguished.
